column1: # MARATHI PENDING (port 63, DESIGN-port63 §3). Amit, 16 Nov 2026: "Survey to Quote journey is priority. Let amit
# verify it end to end in English then only start Marathi transformation." So a key added for the journey is built
# and verified in English first: its value in strings-mr.json is its ENGLISH for now, and the key is listed here.
# THESE KEYS WAIT FOR AMIT'S END-TO-END VERIFICATION OF THE SURVEY TO QUOTE JOURNEY IN ENGLISH. Nobody writes their
# Marathi before that. A key leaves this list in the commit that writes its Marathi, and from then on TxRenderTest's
# Latin scans read it like every other key.
#   key<TAB>English   the English exactly as strings-en.json has it (MrPendingTest holds the three equal, byte for byte)
# TxRenderTest's two Latin scans skip the keys listed here, and only those. No existing Marathi value is ever listed.
# Port 63 slice Q1 (16 Nov 2026) added fourteen: a four-corner mark's texts (the nine measure.* words of its sides, its
# diagonal and "to its nearest corner"; sp.shape.*; sp.measure.sides_say_x; sp.file.x_mark_x_shape_unreadable). 27 in all.
# Port 63 slice I1a (16 Nov 2026) added seven: the one step that marks and measures (DESIGN-imagemeter §12, §18) -- the laser
# chip's two lines and the 360's refusal (sp.laser.off / ready / on_360_x), the ▸ slot's two labels (sp.measure.aria.next_x /
# keep), the check's sentence with no figure (sp.measure.check_reading) and sp.reference_shown_mark. 34 in all.
# Port 63 slice I1b (23 Nov 2026) deleted ten whose last reader went (DESIGN-imagemeter §20.2): 24. The review of I1 added one,
# the bar's line after ✓ Save on a NEW capture (sp.msg.saved_filed_on_back, §22): 25 in all.
# Port 63 P2N (23 Nov 2026) deleted that one again: ✓ Save on a new capture FILES it on the press, so nothing says
# "filed when you go back" any more (DESIGN-imagemeter §23.1). 24 in all.
# Port 63 slice I2a (23 Nov 2026) added five: the panel that slides up (DESIGN-imagemeter §12, §23.2) -- its Fine move act and its
# Unlock all (sp.sheet.fine_move / unlock_all), the code chip's and the panel's name for a screen reader (sp.sheet.aria.open_x), and the
# two cells of Fine move's pad read out (sp.fine.aria.step_x / done). 29 in all.
# Port 63 slice Q2a (23 Nov 2026) added two: the four-corner mark on the screen (DESIGN-quad §11) -- the closing check's sentence with
# NO figure (sp.measure.sides_say_x: the key Q1 added under this name quoted an estimate and went in slice I1b; this is its sentence
# re-worded) and what a refused corner nudge of Fine move's pad says (sp.shape.corner_stops). 31 in all.
# Port 63 slice F4b (23 Nov 2026) added six: the tree's rename dialog (android/docs/port63/DESIGN-tree.md §3) -- why a client or a project
# cannot be renamed from this phone (app.client_office_record_renamed / app.project_office_record_renamed: the office's record;
# app.client_s5_not_renamed / app.project_s5_not_renamed: S5 holds it) and why a site or a project S5 holds is not removed
# Port 63 slice F4c (23 Nov 2026) added four: a project's Site row (android/docs/port63/DESIGN-tree.md §7) -- the banner after one project
# was given another site (app.msg.moved_to_x), why its site cannot be changed from this phone (app.project_site_not_changed_here), why a
# move waits for a photo still on its way to S5 (app.project_capture_on_way_not_moved) and the refusal of a blank site, the bucket or the
# site it is already at (app.not_moved_pick_another_site). 41 in all.
